summary: Correctly resolves the data-loss bug for non-numeric (CharField) primary keys by also treating an empty-string FK attname as 'not yet set' so the saved related object's pk is copied. Targeted and functionally correct; only minor idiom/readability nits.

issues.description: Hardcodes `== ""` instead of the project-idiomatic `getattr(self, field.attname) in field.empty_values`, which would generalize to all empty sentinels and read as more deliberate. Functionally equivalent for FK attnames (integer 0 is unaffected since `0 == ""` is False), so not blocking, but a maintainer would likely prefer the empty_values form.
Calls `getattr(self, field.attname)` twice in the same condition; could bind to a local (e.g. walrus) for clarity and to avoid the redundant lookup. Trivial.
